mode.title: Mode
mode.description: summary = per-expiry put/call ratios + ATM implied vol + open interest (the dashboard). options = the full option chain, one row per instrument. dvol = the Deribit volatility index time series.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: Which underlyings to pull, e.g. BTC, ETH.

optionType.title: Option type (options mode)
optionType.description: Filter the option chain to calls, puts, or both.

expiries.title: Expiries (optional)
expiries.description: Filter to specific expiries in Deribit format, e.g. 28AUG26, 26DEC26. Empty = all listed expiries.

minOpenInterest.title: Min open interest (options mode)
minOpenInterest.description: Skip option instruments with open interest below this (in contracts). 0 = no minimum.

sortBy.title: Sort by (options mode)
sortBy.description: Order the option chain by open interest, USD volume, or implied vol.

dvolHours.title: DVOL lookback hours (dvol mode)
dvolHours.description: How many hours of volatility-index history to return.

dvolResolution.title: DVOL resolution seconds (dvol mode)
dvolResolution.description: Candle resolution in seconds, e.g. 3600 = hourly, 86400 = daily.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
